scientific_question: Can the exact LLMLingua model file identities and payload hashes be learned from immutable Git and LFS metadata without downloading any model payload?
decision_informed: Whether an exact bounded model materialization manifest can be frozen for StructMem.
scientific_evidence_role: model metadata discovery only; no model payload, import, lifecycle, numerical, superiority, or SOTA claim

execution_contract.wave1_non_interference: This small metadata-only Git operation may run during Wave1. It must not checkout or materialize any LFS payload, install a package, call an API model, or start a GPU process.

acceptance: The immutable revision exists in the cloned official repository.
Every tree blob is inventoried by path Git object id byte size and SHA-256.
model.safetensors is a syntactically valid LFS pointer with an exact payload SHA-256 and byte size.
No LFS payload exists in the worktree and model_payload_materialized is false.
The metadata clone remains within 64 MiB.
The evidence root contains TERMINAL_ACCEPTED and a verified evidence inventory.
failure: Any collision, network or Git error, revision mismatch, unsupported tree entry, invalid model pointer, payload appearance, byte-ceiling breach, timeout, or retry seals TERMINAL_REJECTED and preserves the partial target.
next_gate_after_acceptance: Convert the accepted tree and LFS identities into an allowlisted exact model materialization manifest. Metadata acceptance alone never authorizes model download.
prohibited_actions: checking out or smudging a Git LFS or Xet model payload
downloading model.safetensors or any other model payload
starting a lifecycle or numerical run
